g.text: Diagram 2: Operational Data Journey • Smart India Hackathon 2026 (Problem Statement 26128) • Master Case: Ganga (Baramati)
Case #PS-2026-004281 • Animal: Ganga (Gir Cow, 4.5 Yrs) • Ear-Tag: MH-PUN-0241 • Farmer: Ramesh Patil (Baramati, Pune)
Initial Vitals: Temp 104.8°F | Skin Nodules | Milk Drop -60%
Urgent SLA (<2h) Assigned to Local Vet
Alert pushed to Dr. Anand Deshmukh console
Sample Order Dispatched to Field Kit
Tasks Pashu Sakhi for physical specimen pickup
Triggers district alert & spatial cluster evaluation
🚨 Cluster Found: 7 cases in Baramati Taluka
Prompts district officer for response authorization
Field teams deploy to Baramati perimeter
• Informs all livestock owners in 5km buffer
Farmers isolate sick cattle & bring herds to camp
• Ganga shows nodule resolution in 10 days
• Pashu Sakhi logs full recovery in app
Central Platform returns to active baseline monitoring
HOW PASHUSURAKSHA SOLVES THE PROBLEM STATEMENT (SIH PS 26128):
1. Lowers reporting latency from 14 days to <2 hours through multi-channel rural edge ingestion (App, Voice IVR, Offline Sentinel).
2. Combines clinical scoring + PostGIS spatial clusters + IMD weather context to prioritize high-risk areas without black-box ML overclaims.
3. Connects Registered Veterinarians, Cold-Chain Lab Testing, District Buffer Logistics, and Farmer Ring Advisories in a verified closed loop.
